scripts.lint: npm run format:check && turbo run lint
scripts.clean:cache: rm -rf .turbo apps/*/.turbo apps/dashboard/.next apps/dashboard/dist apps/backend/dist packages/*/dist
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean:cache && rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules packages/*/node_modules
scripts.db:setup: npm run docker:up && sleep 3 && prisma generate --schema=packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma && prisma db push --schema=packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma && cd packages/database && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:reset: npm run docker:up && sleep 3 && prisma migrate reset --force --schema=packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma && cd packages/database && npm run db:seed
scripts.local:ci:check: npm run lint && npm run build
